fields.name: horizontal_crs
fields.meaning: projected horizontal coordinate reference system identifier; recorded without online registry validation

fields.name: origin_projected_x_m
fields.meaning: projected x coordinate corresponding to local Cartesian (0, 0)

fields.name: origin_projected_y_m
fields.meaning: projected y coordinate corresponding to local Cartesian (0, 0)

fields.name: rotation_rad_ccw
fields.meaning: counter-clockwise rotation from local Cartesian axes to projected axes; accepted exactly and not normalised

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: human-readable identity of the source used to establish the georeference

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: producer-assigned provenance or authority status; not a survey-accuracy claim

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.meaning: SHA-256 digest recorded for the source artifact

fields.name: derivation
fields.meaning: human-readable description of how origin and rotation were derived

transform.rotation_validation: any finite value is accepted exactly and is not normalised
transform.scale: exactly 1; local and projected horizontal coordinates are metres

fields.name: sha256
fields.meaning: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the exact georeference.json bytes, including its single terminating LF
